title: Camera stills
html:
Camera CAM-02 hangs in the service corridor. It stored these two pictures during the speeches. The camera writes its ID and its time into every picture.

Exhibit PDU/03evidence-04.zipcam02_203305.jpg and cam02_204008.jpgDownload

prev_card.title: Down to two suspects
prev_card.html:
Two badges opened the corridor door during the speeches: the badge of Thomas Lefebvre (logistics coordinator) and the badge of Julien Moreau (security supervisor).

The door log only knows badges. You looked each badge_id up in staff.csv to find the person: that lookup is a join, and badge_id is the foreign key that makes it possible. Rows with an empty badge_id are null: someone pressed an exit button and the log does not know who.

fields.label: One still shows a trolley with a covered crate. Which crate ID is on the label?
What time is written on that still?
Going by the time written on that still: whose badge opened the door to the service corridor closest to it? Give the employee ID.

hints: The label sits on the corner of the crate that the cloth does not cover. For the last question you need your answer to stage 3.
In door_log.csv, keep zone = SC, direction = in, result = granted. Which swipe is closest to the time on the still? Look up its badge in staff.csv.
CR-017, 20:40:08. The closest swipe is badge B-422 at 20:40:05: Thomas Lefebvre, EMP-031.
